card.name: Partway through brand names and split terms
card.fires_on: The first pieces of a split-up word, mostly capitalized brand names such as GVOKE, PHEXXI, OPDIVO and YORVIPATH, and the break in CARDIAC ARREST. Also seen on a few short pieces such as 'up' or 'e' in 'e.g.'.

modes.label: Brand name pieces
modes.description: An early piece of an uppercase drug brand name, right before the rest of the name.
modes.example: Administer<< G>>VOKE subcutaneously in the lower abdomen

modes.label: Split medical phrase
modes.description: The break inside the capitalized phrase CARDIAC ARREST.
modes.example: WARNING: QT PROLONGATION, TORSADES DE POINTES, and CARDIAC<< AR>>REST VANFLYTA prolongs the

modes.label: Short list or range pieces
modes.description: A short piece such as 'e' in 'e.g.' or 'up' in 'up to' inside a list or range.

card.writes: It suppresses words about value and size or strength, and promotes unrelated Chinese nouns, so there is no clear link to the text.
card.plain: It fires inside brand names that are split into pieces, such as GVOKE, and a few other short word breaks.
